Anastrozole and letrozole block conversion of androgens to estrogens.
Anchor each drug to its site: the enzyme inhibitors lower DHT; the receptor blockers stop androgen signaling.
Finasteride and dutasteride block the enzyme; spironolactone, flutamide and bicalutamide block the receptor.
Use this slide to reinforce the parallel structure across both pathways: a receptor-blocking strategy and a synthesis/activation-blocking strategy exist on both the estrogen and androgen sides.
